note: ADR 1018: the legal programs whose checker violation sits at a site no run reaches (legal.mjs outcome `unexecuted`) that a person has seen. Such a row needs a look (codes.mjs `rowProblem`: `unexecuted-violation`) unless an entry below matches its grid and id: `explained` (the judge is right that the site never runs and the row is not a checker defect, a lane that never drives the site, say) or `pending-fix` (a real false positive whose fix is the ADR named, held so CI stays green until it lands; the fix's change removes the entry).
